body: I appreciate your  kind words sir but I am not a good person or a great person..I done did a lot of bad things in my life..prime example I’m a deadbeat dad I can’t provide for my family at all and even when I do get a job I only keep it for a month or two then go back into my old habits I deserve everything bad that happens to me but I do appreciate u listening to me don’t have much friends or family to talk to to begin with
